title: claude-code-notification configuration
description: Configuration for the claude-code-notification plugin. Used for both global (~/.config/claude-code-notification/config.json) and per-project (.claude-code-notification.json) configs. Per-project merges over global at field level.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocompletion

ntfy.description: ntfy.sh push notification backend. Sends HTTP POST to an ntfy server.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the ntfy backend

system_notification.description: Native OS desktop notification. Uses osascript on macOS and notify-send on Linux.

enabled.description: Enable or disable system notifications. Enabled by default on fresh installs.

sound.description: Audio playback backend. Uses afplay (macOS) or paplay/aplay (Linux).

on_notification.description: Path to audio file played on Notification events (permission/idle prompts)

on_stop.description: Path to audio file played on Stop events (task complete)

on_stop_failure.description: Path to audio file played on StopFailure events (error). Falls back to on_stop if not set.

custom_script.description: Custom script backend. Runs user-provided scripts with event context in environment variables (CCN_EVENT, CCN_TITLE, CCN_BODY, CCN_HOSTNAME, CCN_PROJECT).

enabled.description: Enable or disable the custom script backend

on_notification.description: Path to script executed on Notification events

on_stop.description: Path to script executed on Stop events

on_stop_failure.description: Path to script executed on StopFailure events
